capabilities: Generate AI responses inline via the /ai slash command
Switch between local (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
Search the web and feed results to the AI as context
extras: Desktop only; generation cannot be cancelled once started; only one provider active at a time; the /ai trigger is fixed; prompts are sent to the provider's API when using cloud models.
motivation: The README's 'Why Inline AI?' section explains the author built it to remove the copy-out/copy-back workflow of using AI outside the editor.
problem: Using AI normally means leaving Obsidian, copying note content into a chat app, and pasting the result back into the note.

relations.evidence: Inline AI supports Ollama. With Ollama, your prompts can be processed locally
You can also connect Inline AI to cloud providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini
